title: Claim Window for Renewal Remittances — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
**NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own) — claim window applied to renewal remittances (tiers without ICC coverage)**

The claim window is measured from the date the renewal bill was issued to the day of the remittance and is 60 days when no flood claim with a date of loss in the expiring term has been reported on the policy, 45 days when such claims were reported and the most recent of them, the one with the latest date of loss, has a payment or a denial on record, and no days otherwise. When the remittance falls outside the window, the remittance before the credits booked with it may not be less than the renewal premium.

| Flood claims with a date of loss in the expiring term | The one with the latest date of loss | Window |
|---|---|---|
| None reported | — | 60 days |
| Reported | Has a payment or a denial on record | 45 days |
| Reported | Has neither | No days |

A date of loss in the expiring term is one on or after its term start. *Hypothetical case:* the only claim of the term was paid; a remittance 50 days after the bill falls outside the 45-day window, while with no claim in the term it would fall inside the 60-day window.
